scope: Source audio UI/real WebAudio observer controls ONLY; browser output muted for shared-host privacy, not audible world/M1 acceptance

cases.name: real observer defaults and integer source position, not linear gain
native master is pre-lookup and channel mute restores an observed value
drag, focus, Escape and external updates preserve source slider values
actual audio failures surface exact codes and unbound/disposed controls cannot dispatch
native music mode IDs retain required authoritative selection feedback, without fabricated tracks
title toggle uses real activation and global mute without rewriting source channel positions
UI disposal detaches the observer but does not dispose the shell's audio graph
